prompt: Create a vertical whimsical storybook illustration in a soft pastel watercolor style. A serene maiden with very long sandy blonde hair stands centered on a rounded green meadow hill, wearing a flowing simple white robe with wide sleeves, hands clasped in prayer at her chest, tiny black dot eyes, rosy cheeks, and a calm expression. Add a warm glowing halo behind her head, partly encircled by a delicate small floral wreath. Surround her with exactly 12 cute white rabbits with pink inner ears and blush cheeks: 6 rabbits in the middle row behind or beside the maiden on the hill, and 6 larger rabbits in the foreground meadow, all in slightly different upright poses. Fill the meadow with many thin green stems, small white daisies, tiny pink flowers, and sparse leaves. Above the scene, create a large arching garland of green vines and pink roses across the top, with dangling leaves and blossoms. Place exactly 1 tiny floating white ghost-like spirit at the top center under the vine arch, and scatter tiny star sparkles and miniature flower petals across the warm beige background. Use fine ink outlines, muted cream, blush pink, sage green, and warm gold tones, with a gentle magical glow, symmetrical composition, lots of empty airy space above the character, and a dreamy fairy-tale atmosphere. No text, no border, no watermark.

promptZh: 创作一幅竖版奇幻绘本风格插画，采用柔和的粉彩水彩画风。画面中心是一位神态安详的少女，拥有 非常长的沙金色头发，站在圆润的绿色草丘中央，身穿简单的白色宽袖长袍，双手合十于胸前，眼睛为小黑点，脸颊红润，表情宁静。在她的脑后添加一个温暖的发光光环，光环部分被精致的小花环围绕。在她的周围放置 12 只可爱的白兔，耳朵内侧为粉色，脸颊带有腮红：其中 6 只位于草丘上少女的身后或身侧，另外 6 只较大的兔子位于前景草地上，所有兔子姿态各异，呈直立状。草地上布满细长的绿茎、小白雏菊、细小的粉色花朵和稀疏的叶片。在画面上方，绘制一个巨大的拱形花环，由绿藤和粉玫瑰组成，带有垂下的叶片和花朵。在顶部中心、藤蔓拱门下方放置 1 个微小的漂浮白色幽灵状精灵，并在温暖的米色背景上散布细小的星光和微型花瓣。使用精细的墨线勾勒，色调采用柔和的奶油色、腮红粉、鼠尾草绿和暖金色，带有柔和的魔法光晕，构图对称，角色上方留有大量空灵的留白，营造出梦幻般的童话氛围。无文字，无边框，无水印。
